flags: The state inventory supplies the scenic designation, date and extent, but no designation rationale or road-building history. The cache offers no route-specific grades, curves or travel time. History is limited to designation and the separately named recreation trail. Overview is intentionally shorter than 200 words because additional driving history and character are not supported.

Material strip miles place McKee at 16.08 and Cruise at 32.67; overview and moments follow that north-to-south order. Arthur Lakes Log House lies north of McKee by the supplied coordinates and remains a separate excursion.

Cruise is called a Laurel County community in the cache, outside the official Rockcastle/Jackson corridor. Retained the current moment as a separate excursion using its unchanged coordinates; its relationship to the route needs editorial confirmation. Removed the unsupported crossroads description.

Arthur Lakes Log House and Cruise remain short because their cache pages are thin; McKee also stays concise to avoid unrelated town facts. No evidence establishes current house access, visibility from a public road or surviving post-office premises; no visits or notice fields are promised.
The current Sheltowee name explanation is cached but lacks a Shawnee or primary historical source here, so it was omitted. The alcohol vote is supported but omitted as unrelated to the drive.
